title: Well and badly approximable sets, and rapid winning
summary: The set of $τ$-approximable numbers, $\mathcal W(τ)$, has genuinely fractional Hausdorff dimension, whereas the set of inhomogeneously badly approximable numbers, $\Bad^γ$, has full Hausdorff dimension. We determine the Hausdorff dimension of their intersection by introducing the $Ψ$-rapid game, a scale-sensitive refinement of the rapid game of Hatefi and Simmons (preprint 2024). For every approximation function $ψ$, we prove that $\mathcal W(ψ)\cap\Bad^γ$ is strong $Ψ$-rapid winning for a natural gauge $Ψ$ determined by $ψ$.
